title: Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbi Ada of Jaffa
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:7, saying in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah in the name of Rabbi Zeira that one must say them (the ten sons of Haman) in one breath; and in Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7 he said, “He becomes like a pochech (one whose garment is torn open).” He is likewise mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 43:3: “Rabbi Berekhyah said in the name of Rabbi Chiyya bar Ada of Jaffa, in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani.” He is likewise mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, piska HaChodesh, Vayikra Rabbah 33:6 and Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:10; in Bereshit Rabbah 38:3 it reads Rabbi Chiyya, grandson of Rabbi Ada of Jaffa.

notes.text: פוחח denotes someone whose clothing is torn open in the repeated-rending context. Saved Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7 confirms that context. Its Megillah 3:7 has Chiyya and Yirmeyah together in Zeira’s name, against the supplied nested chain; both remain disclosed. The supplied son/grandson variant remains meaningful.
